hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB (held near 250 MHz by power and thermal limits)

proposals.statement: Parents struggle to get information from the school because fee statements are printed and sent home in learners' bags but half never reach parents

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents.

proposals.statement: Reports are printed, put in envelopes, and sent home but take a week of admin staff's time every term for about nine hundred learners

evidence.quote: Printed, put in envelopes, sent home. For about nine hundred learners that's a week of the admin staff's time every term.

proposals.statement: Notices are sent via WhatsApp broadcast lists and email but parents who change numbers fall off the lists

evidence.quote: Those go on WhatsApp broadcast lists, and by email. But a broadcast list fills up, so we have five of them now, and parents who change their numbers just fall off.

proposals.statement: Absence notes are handwritten in learners' homework diaries or emailed to class teachers who may not pass them to the office, causing some learners to be marked absent for three days without office awareness

evidence.quote: Handwritten in the learner's homework diary, or an email to the class teacher, who may or may not pass it on to the office. We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: Parents need a place to see what they owe, their child's reports, and school notices, and to report their child's sickness

evidence.quote: One place where a parent can see what they owe, their child's reports and the school's notices, and tell us when their child is sick.

proposals.statement: The school wants to stop printing reports and fee statements to save costs and admin time

evidence.quote: And for us to stop printing. That's a real cost, and a lot of hours.

proposals.statement: Parents need to see the current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference for EFT payments

evidence.quote: The current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: Reports must be released as PDFs on the same day for all parents, with no early access

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF, the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone. We don't want some families seeing them before others.

proposals.statement: Parents must fill in absence notes with reason and dates, and the class teacher and office must see them immediately

evidence.quote: Yes, the reason and the dates, and the class teacher and the office both see it straight away.

proposals.statement: SchoolBase 7, from about 2014, runs on a server in the admin block and holds learners, parents, fees, and marks

evidence.quote: On a server in the admin block. It's SchoolBase 7, from about 2014 I think. It holds the learners, the parents, fees and marks.

proposals.statement: The portal must be light with small pages and PDFs only downloaded when opened to accommodate parents with limited data

evidence.quote: Small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The portal must be zero-rated by the network to help parents with expensive data costs

evidence.quote: Yes. And could it be zero-rated? I heard some schools have arranged that with the networks.

proposals.statement: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see information about that learner, with court orders for some divorced parents

evidence.quote: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner.
And with some divorced parents, one of them may not see anything at all. There's a court order on about a dozen files.

proposals.statement: Data must be hosted in South Africa as per the board's decision

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of a generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal should support isiZulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in isiZulu

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in isiZulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in isiZulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal should have big, clear text for parents with eye problems and support for screen readers

evidence.quote: And big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal must respect parent restrictions set by the office and host data in South Africa

evidence.quote: the portal has to respect restrictions per parent, and the office has to be able to set them
The board said it must be hosted in South Africa

proposals.statement: The portal should support isiZulu language for notices and main screens

evidence.quote: If the notices and the main screens could be in isiZulu too, that would mean a lot

proposals.statement: The portal must have large, clear text and be accessible to screen readers

evidence.quote: big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader

proposals.statement: The portal must use the school's maroon color scheme

evidence.quote: please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year, pending board approval

evidence.quote: The finance committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand rand for the first year, all in

proposals.statement: The portal must be ready by June 26 for term two reports

evidence.quote: The term two reports go out on the twenty-sixth of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal

proposals.statement: The school has 1,650 parent contacts, with many families having both parents and grandparents listed

evidence.quote: It's not fourteen hundred parent contacts, it's about sixteen hundred and fifty. A lot of families have both parents and a grandparent listed

proposals.statement: If the first report day goes poorly, parents may lose trust in the portal immediately

evidence.quote: a risk I see is that if the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal straight away

proposals.statement: The portal will start with a trial for grade eight term one reports in April

evidence.quote: Let's do grade eight in April as the trial
Agreed, grade eight first

proposals.statement: The school has only one IT person who works two days a week

evidence.quote: Me, honestly. I'm the only IT person, and only two days a week

proposals.statement: Booking slots for parents' evenings is planned for later but not for the first version

evidence.quote: Eventually, booking slots for parents' evenings. But not now
